integrity: All claims are mathematical statements in this package; no external independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The one-third ratio is an asymptotic ordering boundary, not a proved unique finite-size crossing. The critical window q/p->1/3 is unresolved. Exact conditional disintegration is a support lemma related to the complete-bipartite law, not itself claimed as the main novelty. Finite tests supplement rather than replace analytic proofs; bibliographic overlap may remain.
title: A one-third spectral crossover in complete split-graph Lipschitz dual balls
